correctness.rationale: The source itself gives \(\|q\|^2=L^2\), \(q\cdot p=0\), and \(\dot q=p\). Exact rational substitution yields nonzero tangent defects \(51/100000,51/100000,11/100000\) for the three listed states, while each has the correct position radius. The identity \(\dot R=2q\cdot p\) then forces immediate departure from the sphere. A standalone exact polynomial checker also verifies the factorization of the printed equation (3.5) and the defect dynamics after clearing \(L^2\). Risk is limited to transcription of the source equations and listed data; both were cross-checked against the primary full text.

value.rationale: The defect concerns the defining geometric condition of the source’s holonomic system and directly changes the interpretation of its central numerical evidence: the reported Lyapunov, sensitivity, and Poincaré trajectories are not trajectories on the claimed constrained phase space.
